name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''

---

**Describe the bug**
A description of what the bug is.

**Steps to Reproduce**
Include the course, menu or action, whether this is Linux or Android, and the commit or APK version. For Android, include the device model and selected Vulkan driver. Describe any difference between first launch, level load and Retry.

**Files**
Attach the relevant log and a screenshot if useful. Do not upload game files, packages, keys or the complete app data directory. Share a save only if needed to reproduce the issue.
